claims.statement: 1977 study: repeated statements rated more true across three occasions, including false items
claims.limit: Ratings of plausible items; no universal belief or behavior claim.

claims.statement: 2010 synthesis included 51 studies and distinguished within-item vs between-item contrasts
claims.limit: Different scoring criteria and effect sizes.

claims.statement: 2015 experiments found repetition effect despite demonstrable relevant knowledge
claims.limit: Not claim that education never helps.

claims.statement: 2019 study found repeated statements gained credibility across plausibility categories
claims.limit: Tasks measure truth ratings, not any infinite susceptibility.

claims.statement: 2018 fake-news headline study found small changes in perceived accuracy
claims.limit: Two preregistered studies; not identical to live creator traffic or sales.

claims.statement: 2026 synthesis included 182 studies, 366 effect sizes, N=31,184
claims.limit: Study years 1977–2025, report published 2026-02-27.

claims.statement: 2026 bias-adjusted g=.37 with 95% CI [.30,.44]
claims.limit: Small pooled effect; large heterogeneity; correction sensitive to assumptions.

claims.statement: Early accuracy attention prevented later bias when participants possessed relevant knowledge
claims.limit: Do not claim this always works without knowledge.

claims.statement: Correction can include a clear alternative explanation, with low documented familiarity-backfire risk
claims.limit: Not a guarantee for all corrections.

claims.statement: Repetition of seller product ads proves Zen12 mental or health benefits
claims.limit: Truth-rating studies provide no product-specific intervention evidence.

claims.statement: Inspire3 describes Zen12, Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots
claims.limit: Catalog inclusion does not establish effectiveness or partner status.

claims.statement: Zen12 Premium standard seller page advertises 12 levels and 48 MP3 tracks
claims.limit: Content not independently delivered or tested by FV.

claims.statement: Standard Zen12 seller page advertises one-year refund
claims.limit: Actual eligibility, checkout, refunds and support handling unverified.

claims.statement: Separate Zen12 promotional page contains different coupon/price framing
claims.limit: Do not substitute offer or imply discount authorized.

claims.statement: The public Inspire3 publisher portal establishes FV-specific acceptance
claims.limit: Public enrollment page is not named publisher agreement.

claims.statement: The public portal publishes generic 60%+ language, thus FV earns that rate
claims.limit: Do not ascribe generic marketing compensation to this publisher.

claims.statement: A near-link commission disclosure is required before a commercial recommendation
claims.limit: Disclosure needs clear placement and language, not a distant policy link.

claims.statement: A health benefit claim needs adequate evidence for the particular claim/product
claims.limit: General mechanism evidence cannot stand in for product evidence.

claims.statement: The Focus Fieldbook is free and uses one existing Jetpack/Dispatch route
claims.limit: Subscriptions must be provider-confirmed; pageviews are not confirmed leads.

claims.statement: Paid FV-owned Mind SKU is currently eligible, rights-cleared and functioning
claims.limit: No rights, live inventory, settlement/refunds and successful checkout evidence.

claims.statement: R257 rendered film has seven WebVTT cues matching revised R268 B text
claims.limit: Custody from GitHub VTT only; binary is local review, not hosted / browser QA.

claims.statement: A web click is a merchant-confirmed sale or settled commission
claims.limit: Separate outbound from merchant-confirmed paid event; no zero-revenue assumption.

claims.statement: Historical Puységur observations validate presumed magnetic fluid
claims.limit: Historical reporting is not physical proof.
